access.name: Context

side_effects: Drains SDL's event queue every frame (SDL_PollEvent): no other system may poll it, and the capture's scripted events pushed by Capture::beginFrame are read here.

Escape or closing the window sets Input::EXIT, which ends the main loop of Game::start.

Calls ImGui::NewFrame every tick: every system that draws an ImGui window must come after it in the frame; the UI pass renders the frame.

systems.name: Terrain
systems.summary: GPU marching cubes: meshes the nearest pending chunks into per-slot vertex buffers and indirect draws, recycles slots, destroys chunks on their way out.

access.name: Context
access.effect: the device, VMA and the compute command buffer of the frame; stored as Context*

access.name: TerrainBuffers
access.effect: the indirect buffer and its stride; a vertex buffer appended per new slot

access.name: ChunkGPU
access.effect: slot of a chunk's mesh: the old slot is freed when remeshed or destroyed

access.name: ChunkReady
access.effect: set when the mesh is in this frame's compute submit: drawable

access.name: ChunkTriangles
access.effect: removed when remeshed; with ray tracing, set NUM_FRAMES later from the read back vertex count

access.name: ChunkMeshPending
access.effect: the chunks to mesh; removed once dispatched

access.name: ChunkC
access.effect: centre (nearest first) and pos (push constants)

access.name: ChunkVolume
access.effect: the 67^3 densities copied into the staging ring

access.name: ChunkDestroying
access.effect: chunks out of view distance (without ChunkGenerating): their slot is freed later and the entity destroyed

access.name: ChunkGenerating
access.effect: excluded: a chunk a worker still writes is not destroyed yet

access.name: Camera
access.effect: position: the nearest chunks are meshed first (origin without a camera)

access.name: RenderSettings
access.effect: streaming.chunk_meshes: chunks meshed a frame (1 to max_per_frame = 8)

side_effects: Reads ./resources/mclookup.bin (throws when it is not 256 x 16 bytes) and ./resources/shaders/marchingcubes.comp.glsl.spv in init.

Allocates GPU memory: indirect buffer (2048 slots), staging ring (ring size x 8 chunks), lookup texel buffer, a 3 MB vertex buffer per slot (2^15 triangles x 3 vertices x 32 bytes, ray tracing usages when enabled), a readback buffer with ray tracing; descriptor pool and sets, compute pipeline.

Records into the compute command buffer of the frame: indirect resets, one dispatch per chunk, a clamp pass, with ray tracing copies of the indirect commands to the readback buffer; Tracy GPU zone "Marching cubes", CPU zone "Mesh chunks", plot "Chunks meshed".
Destroys the entities of chunks marked ChunkDestroying (all their components go with them).
Logs a warning "Terrain : out of chunk slots" when 2048 slots are used.
The destructor waits for the device to be idle and clears its components and TerrainBuffers.

Creates capture_dir and writes <capture_dir>/<shot>.png (stb_image_write) from the renderer's readback; logs each shot and late shots.
Fails the run (Game::start returns 1) when a shot waits more than 1200 frames for the terrain or a PNG cannot be written; a late sequence frame delays the ones after it.

components.name: Input
components.summary: The window's keyboard, mouse and window state of the frame, written by Input (SDL events) and UI.

fields.name: text
fields.desc: text typed this frame (UTF-8), consumed by UI

fields.name: on
fields.desc: held actions (FORWARD W, BACKWARD S, LEFT A, RIGHT D, PAUSE P, MENU M, DEBUG K, BACKSPACE, TAB, ROTATE_LEFT/RIGHT arrows, ANGLE_UP/DOWN arrows, UP Space, DOWN LCtrl, SPRINT LShift, VR_RIG R, INTERACT E, CURSOR LAlt) and the events RESIZE, EXIT (Escape / window closed); some are one-shot flags cleared by their consumer (PAUSE, VR_RIG, CURSOR, EXIT)

fields.name: mousePos
fields.desc: cursor in window pixels, updated while focused

fields.name: mouseWheel
fields.desc: wheel notches of the last wheel event this frame

fields.name: mouseDelta
fields.desc: relative mouse motion this frame

fields.name: screenSize
fields.desc: window size in pixels

fields.name: mouseLeft / mouseRight / mouseMiddle
fields.desc: raw button state

fields.name: leftDown / rightDown / middleDown
fields.desc: button state for the scene: false while ImGui wants the mouse (UI)

fields.name: leftClick / rightClick / middleClick
fields.desc: pressed this frame, cleared by UI while ImGui wants the mouse

fields.name: focused
fields.desc: the window has the keyboard focus

fields.name: window_showing
fields.desc: false while minimised

components.notes: Emplaced by InputSys's constructor (so before any preinit); Game::start reads Input::EXIT to end the loop. CameraWalk sets EXIT at the end of a walk with exit. Not the player components (MouseKeyboardInput reads it for the DesktopView player).

components.name: Time
components.summary: The game calendar of the Time system: seconds since start, speed and pause.

fields.name: current
fields.desc: game seconds since start

fields.name: speed
fields.desc: game seconds per real second (60)

fields.name: last_speed_modifier
fields.desc: the modifier P brings back

fields.name: dt
fields.desc: game seconds of this frame (speed x modifier x dt x 10, truncated)

fields.name: minute / hour / day / month / year
fields.desc: lengths in seconds (28-day months, 4 seasons a year)

components.notes: Emplaced by Time in preinit. Date (same header) splits a time into years, months (Spring..Winter), days, hours, minutes, seconds for display. No other system reads it: the sky has its own clock (Sky).

components.name: ModelRenderable
components.summary: Draws the ModelC held by another entity (from ModelManager) at this entity's Transform, tinted.

fields.name: model
fields.desc: entity holding the ModelC (ModelManager::load / add)

fields.name: tint
fields.desc: colour multiplied with the material (1 by default)

components.notes: Scenes and prefabs: { "path": <under resources/>, "tint": [r, g, b, a] }; only valid once the renderer exists (registered in register_view.cpp: ComponentError without ModelManager or when the model cannot load); saved back as its tint only. Read by ModelPass and RayScene; made by spawnBox, VRControl, ModelLineup, PlayerModels, WorldView, SphereView, GaitView, AnimalAgentView.

components.name: WorldStepperState
components.summary: Where the drawn worlds are between their last two ticks, and the Worlds panel state.

fields.name: alpha
fields.desc: accumulator / h after this frame's ticks: interpolation factor between PhysicsPose prev and current (1 when paused)

fields.name: h
fields.desc: fixed tick of world 0 (WorldClock::dt), 1/60 s by default

fields.name: paused
fields.desc: Pause checkbox

fields.name: step_once
fields.desc: Step button: one tick while paused

fields.name: ticks
fields.desc: ticks stepped since start

components.notes: Emplaced by WorldStepper in preinit; read by WorldView, SphereView, VRRoller, DesktopRoller (all treat it as optional, alpha 1 without).

components.name: WorldViewLink
components.summary: On a host entity made by WorldView: the world body or shape it draws.

fields.name: world
fields.desc: world index

fields.name: entity
fields.desc: entity in that world's registry

components.notes: Created and destroyed by WorldView only (its own map is what it reads); lets other code tell mirrored entities apart.

components.name: CameraWalk
components.summary: Where the walk of the CameraWalk system is: its line, progress, started and finished.

fields.name: start
fields.desc: x, z of the start of the line

fields.name: heading
fields.desc: radians, as Camera::yaw (0 toward -z)

fields.name: distance
fields.desc: length of the line, m

fields.name: progress
fields.desc: metres along the line

fields.name: started
fields.desc: false while the terrain, plants, animals and lighting load

fields.name: finished
fields.desc: the end of the line or of the path is reached

components.notes: Emplaced by CameraWalk in preinit, written by it only; for tools and tests that wait on the walk.

components.name: VRHands
components.summary: The two entities that follow the VR controllers (VRControl).

fields.name: hands
fields.desc: left, right (VRInput::left / right); entt::null without a headset

components.notes: Defined in an anonymous namespace of vr_control.cpp: only VRControl sees it. Emplaced in preinit, filled in init.
